plugin.name: MarketWatch
plugin.author: Eric
plugin.purpose: Watch the market and auction channel for wanted items; one-click bids.

muclient.script:
require "serialize"
-- Aardwolf's shipped silent command-capture module (MUSHclient/lua/ -- wrapped_captures.lua). Brackets a command with echo tags and gags the whole -- response, so we can read "market list" without it hitting the screen. local gHaveCapture = pcall (require, "wrapped_captures")
-- gmcphelper gives us gmcp("room.info.num"), which asks the GMCP handler -- plugin for its CURRENT cached value. That matters: room.info is only -- broadcast when you change rooms, so a plugin that only listens would not -- know where you are until you next moved. local gHaveGmcp = pcall (require, "gmcphelper")
-- ===================================================================== -- Colours / echo helpers (standard theme) -- ===================================================================== -- Only these four colours are used anywhere in this plugin. local CLR_TAG = "#875FFF" -- x099 brackets, and muted secondary detail local CLR_NAME = "#00D7FF" -- x045 plugin name, and anything needing notice local CLR_MSG = "#FFFFFF" -- W message text local CLR_HI = "#00FF87" -- x048 values, commands, clickable actions
-- Roles mapped onto the four, so the rest of the code can stay readable. local CLR_WARN = CLR_NAME -- refusals / attention local CLR_DIM = CLR_TAG -- secondary detail lines
local TAG = "MarketWatch"
local function echo (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg) end
local function echoHi (msg, hi, tail) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_MSG, "", msg, CLR_HI, "", hi, CLR_MSG, "", tail or "") end
local function warn (msg) ColourNote (CLR_TAG, "", "[", CLR_NAME, "", TAG, CLR_TAG, "", "] ", CLR_WARN, "", msg) end
local function helpLine (left, right) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-26s", left), CLR_MSG, "", right) end
local function dbg (msg) if gCfg and gCfg.debug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw] " .. msg) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Small utilities -- ===================================================================== local function trim (s) return (tostring (s or ""):match ("^%s*(.-)%s*$")) end
-- Amounts go into commands, so they must always render as plain digits - -- never "1.2e+15", never a trailing ".0". local function intstr (n) return string.format ("%d", math.floor (tonumber (n) or 0)) end
local function commafy (n) local s = tostring (math.floor (tonumber (n) or 0)) local k repeat s, k = s:gsub ("^(%-?%d+)(%d%d%d)", "%1,%2") until k == 0 return s end
-- "1200000000", "1,200,000,000", "1.2b", "500m", "25k" -> number local function parseAmount (s) s = trim (s):gsub (",", ""):lower () local n, suf = s:match ("^(%d+%.?%d*)([kmb]?)$") if not n then return nil end n = tonumber (n) if not n then return nil end if suf == "k" then n = n * 1000 elseif suf == "m" then n = n * 1000000 elseif suf == "b" then n = n * 1000000000 end if n < 1 then return nil end return math.floor (n) end
-- Reduce a name to a comparable form: lowercase, and every character that is -- not a letter or digit becomes a space. This makes decorated / restrung -- names like "|10[Ten of Earth]10|" compare as "10 ten of earth 10", so the -- user never has to type the decoration. local function norm (s) s = tostring (s or ""):lower () s = s:gsub ("[^a-z0-9]", " ") s = s:gsub ("%s+", " ") return trim (s) end
-- Split a watch pattern on "*" into normalised literal pieces. Matching then -- means "these pieces appear, in this order" - which is exactly glob -- semantics, without ever building a Lua pattern out of user text. local function splitGlob (raw) local parts, out = {}, {} local start = 1 while true do local s = raw:find ("*", start, true) if not s then parts [#parts + 1] = raw:sub (start) break end parts [#parts + 1] = raw:sub (start, s - 1) start = s + 1 end for _, p in ipairs (parts) do local n = norm (p) if n ~= "" then out [#out + 1] = n end end return out end
-- Do all pieces appear in order inside hay? (plain find, no pattern magic) local function piecesMatch (hay, pieces) if not pieces or #pieces == 0 then return false end local pos = 1 for _, p in ipairs (pieces) do local s, e = hay:find (p, pos, true) if not s then return false end pos = e + 1 end return true end
-- Does a prefix of p (>= 4 chars) sit at the very end of vis? That means the -- match may simply have been cut off by the 28-char column. local function straddles (vis, p) local maxk = math.min (#vis, #p) for k = maxk, 4, -1 do if vis:sub (-k) == p:sub (1, k) then return true end end return false end
-- Could this pattern still match once the truncated tail is known? local function couldMatchTruncated (vis, pieces) if not pieces or #pieces == 0 then return false end local pos = 1 for i, p in ipairs (pieces) do local s, e = vis:find (p, pos, true) if not s then -- earlier pieces matched, so the rest may live in the cut-off tail if i > 1 then return true end return straddles (vis, p) end pos = e + 1 end return true end
-- flatten one captured style-run list into plain text local function styleText (styles) if type (styles) ~= "table" then return "" end local parts = {} for _, run in ipairs (styles) do parts [#parts + 1] = run.text or "" end return table.concat (parts) end
local function textsOf (lines) local t = {} for _, s in ipairs (lines or {}) do t [#t + 1] = styleText (s) end return t end
-- ===================================================================== -- Persistent data (own file - SetVariable is lost on manual reinstall) -- ===================================================================== -- ===================================================================== -- The commands sent to the MUD. Fixed, not configurable. -- marketplace ("long auction"): one command does both jobs -- lbid <num> read an item's stats box -- lbid <num> <amt> proxy confirm place a proxy bid -- lbid <num> <buyout> buy it outright ("proxy" is -- meaningless - there is nothing to -- bid up to - so the short form) -- live auction channel: a different system entirely -- bid <num> <amt> -- ===================================================================== local CMD_BID = "lbid $num $amt proxy confirm" local CMD_BUY = "lbid $num $amt" local CMD_PROBE = "lbid $num" local CMD_AUC = "bid $num $amt"
local DATA_FILE = "MarketWatch_data.lua"
gCfg = { -- $num and $amt are substituted before sending auc = true, -- watch the auction channel at all mkt = true, -- watch the market channel too aucdebug = false, popup = true, -- pop a window up for act-now opportunities withdraw = false, -- pull gold from the bank when a bid falls short withdrawroom = 0, -- only ever do that in this room (0 = unset) deep = false, -- probe EVERY truncated row, not just likely ones probe_delay = 0.6, -- seconds between silent stats probes probe_max = 30, -- hard cap on probes per scan debug = false, }
local gWatch = {} -- { {raw=, pieces=, max=, added=}, ... }
local function dataPath () return GetInfo (66) .. DATA_FILE end
-- Items we have already put a bid (or buyout) on. num -> os.time(). -- Persisted: a proxy bid stands until the auction ends, so re-offering the -- link would only ever waste gold. Pruned when the item leaves the market. gBid = {}
-- Same idea for the LIVE auction channel. Kept separate because auction item -- numbers are a completely different, small, recycled namespace ("Num 97") and -- would otherwise collide with market numbers ("64817"). gAucBid = {}
-- Buyout prices learned from the market channel ("This item has a buyout price -- of N"). That announcement is the one place a buyout is stated in a form we -- have actually seen, so it is remembered and reused by 'marketw' scans later. gKnownBuyout = {}
local AUC_BID_TTL = 3600 -- forget an auction bid after an hour local AUC_TTL = 300 -- an auction line's link goes stale after 5 minutes
local function saveData () local plain = {} for i, w in ipairs (gWatch) do plain [i] = { raw = w.raw, max = w.max, added = w.added } end -- serialize wants string keys for a sparse map local bid = {} for num, t in pairs (gBid) do bid [tostring (num)] = t end local abid = {} for num, t in pairs (gAucBid) do abid [tostring (num)] = t end local buy = {} for num, p in pairs (gKnownBuyout) do buy [tostring (num)] = p end local body = "return " .. serialize.save_simple ( { watch = plain, cfg = gCfg, bid = bid, aucbid = abid, buyout = buy }) local tmp = dataPath () .. ".tmp" local f, err = io.open (tmp, "w") if not f then warn ("cannot save watch list: " .. tostring (err)) return false end f:write (body) f:close () os.remove (dataPath ()) os.rename (tmp, dataPath ()) return true end
local function loadData () local f = io.open (dataPath (), "r") if not f then return end local body = f:read ("*a") f:close () local chunk = loadstring (body) if not chunk then warn ("watch list file is corrupt - starting empty") return end local ok, t = pcall (chunk) if not ok or type (t) ~= "table" then return end if type (t.cfg) == "table" then -- Only keys that still exist are restored, so settings retired in later -- versions (the old bidcmd / buycmd / cap) are ignored, not resurrected. for k, v in pairs (t.cfg) do if gCfg [k] ~= nil then gCfg [k] = v end end end gWatch = {} for _, w in ipairs (t.watch or {}) do if w.raw and w.max then gWatch [#gWatch + 1] = { raw = w.raw, max = w.max, added = w.added or 0, pieces = splitGlob (w.raw), } end end gBid = {} for num, when in pairs (t.bid or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n then gBid [n] = when end end gAucBid = {} local now = os.time () for num, when in pairs (t.aucbid or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n and now - when < AUC_BID_TTL then gAucBid [n] = when end end gKnownBuyout = {} for num, price in pairs (t.buyout or {}) do local n = tonumber (num) if n then gKnownBuyout [n] = price end end end
-- ===================================================================== -- Scan state -- ===================================================================== local gScanning = false local gScanStart = 0
-- Live state from GMCP local gRoom = nil -- room.info "num" local gGold = nil -- char.worth "gold" (on hand) local gBank = nil -- char.worth "bank"
-- The last bid we actually sent, so that a "not enough gold" reply can be -- tied back to it. { num, amt, auction, when } local gLastBid = nil local BID_FAIL_WINDOW = 20 -- seconds a failure may still refer to that bid
-- Where are we? Ask the GMCP handler for its cached room.info first - it -- always knows, even if we have not moved since loading. The value fed to us -- by room.info broadcasts is only a fallback. local function currentRoom () if gHaveGmcp then -- gmcphelper's gmcp() stores its result in a global called "data" and -- returns that global. If the lookup fails it leaves the PREVIOUS value -- in place, so clear it first - otherwise a failed read hands back the -- last room we successfully saw. data = nil local ok, v = pcall (gmcp, "room.info.num") if ok then local n = tonumber (v) if n then return n end end end return gRoom end local gRows = {} -- num -> row table for the CURRENT scan only local gOrder = {} -- nums, in market-list order, that we will report local gQueue = {} -- nums still to probe local gProbeCount = 0 local gHidBid = 0 -- matches skipped this scan: we already bid local gHidPrice = 0 -- matches skipped this scan: bidding is already over our max
local SCAN_TTL = 600 -- a scan's results go stale after 10 minutes
-- ===================================================================== -- Parsing 'market list' -- ===================================================================== -- Fixed-width layout, verified against real output: -- 1..6 num | 7 sp | 8..35 item (28) | 36 sp | 37..39 lvl | 40 sp -- 41..45 type | 46 sp | 47..62 last bid | 63 sp | 64..67 bids | 68 sp | 69.. time local function parseListRow (line) if #line < 68 then return nil end local num = tonumber (trim (line:sub (1, 6))) if not num then return nil end if line:sub (7, 7) ~= " " or line:sub (36, 36) ~= " " then return nil end
local rawname = line:sub (8, 35) local lvl = tonumber (trim (line:sub (37, 39))) local typefld = line:sub (41, 45) local bidtxt = trim (line:sub (47, 62)) local bids = tonumber (trim (line:sub (64, 67))) local timeft = trim (line:sub (69))
local star = typefld:find ("*", 1, true) ~= nil local ctype = trim (typefld:gsub ("%*", "")) local vis = trim (rawname)
-- The description column is 28 wide. Obviously cut off if char 28 is not a -- space. But a name cut exactly ON a space shows only 27 characters and -- looks complete, so anything 27 or longer has to be treated as suspect. local maybeCut = #vis >= 27
return { num = num, visible = vis, truncated = maybeCut, level = lvl, ctype = ctype, -- "Gold" / "QP" / ... star = star, -- meaning of '*' is not yet confirmed bid = tonumber ((bidtxt:gsub (",", ""))), bidtxt = bidtxt, bids = bids or 0, timeleft = timeft, } end
-- ===================================================================== -- Parsing the item box from 'lbid <num>' -- -- Verified against real output (2026-08-21). The whole reply is a box of -- "| Label : value |" lines: -- -- | Keywords : daily blessing qreset reset token | -- | Name : Daily Blessing Qreset Token | -- | Type : Treasure Level : 1 | -- ... -- | Market Item Number : 64911 | -- | Item is being sold by : Granuaile | -- | Auction will end in : 3 days and 16:40:04 | -- | Current bid : 25,000,000 gold (Ultimate) | -- -- Still unknown: the label used for a buyout price (this item has none), so -- any label containing "buyout" is accepted. Unreadable fields stay nil, and -- a nil name means no bid link is offered for a truncated row. -- ===================================================================== local function boxValue (line) -- "| Label : value |" -> "label", "value" local inner = line:match ("^%s*|(.*)|%s*$") if not inner then return nil end local label, value = inner:match ("^%s*([%a][%a%s]-)%s*:%s*(.*)$") if not label then return nil end return (label:lower ():gsub ("%s+", " ")), trim (value) end
local function firstNumber (s) local n = s and s:match ("([%d,]+)") return n and tonumber ((n:gsub (",", ""))) or nil end
-- The command that prints the box above. 'lbid <num>' is the verified form; -- the market list footer suggests 'market bid <num>' does the same. local function probeCmd (num) return (CMD_PROBE:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num))) end
local function parseStats (num, lines) local st = { num = num }
for _, t in ipairs (lines) do local label, value = boxValue (t) if label and value ~= "" then if label == "name" then -- first one wins: the stats box comes before the description text if not st.name then st.name = value end elseif label == "keywords" then if not st.keywords then st.keywords = value end elseif label == "market item number" then st.listnum = firstNumber (value) elseif label == "item is being sold by" then st.seller = value:match ("^(%S+)") elseif label == "auction will end in" then st.endsin = value elseif label == "current bid" then -- "25,000,000 gold (Ultimate)" st.bid = firstNumber (value) st.currency = value:match ("^[%d,]+%s+(%a+)") -- The name in brackets is the high bidder as far as I can tell, but -- that is an inference from one sample - it is only ever used to skip -- bidding against yourself, so a wrong guess costs nothing. st.bidder = value:match ("%(([^)]+)%)") elseif label:find ("buyout", 1, true) then st.buyout = firstNumber (value) elseif label:find ("minimum", 1, true) and label:find ("bid", 1, true) then st.minbid = firstNumber (value) end end end
-- The box states its own item number. If it disagrees with the one we asked -- about, the reply is not for our item - throw the whole thing away rather -- than bid on the strength of it. if st.listnum and st.listnum ~= num then return { num = num, mismatch = st.listnum } end
return st end
-- ===================================================================== -- Matching a row against the watch list -- ===================================================================== -- Returns: "sure" | "maybe" | nil, entry -- "sure" = the pattern matched text we can actually see, so it will also -- match the full name (a match inside a prefix implies a match in -- the whole string). -- "maybe" = the row is truncated and the pattern could still match the part -- we cannot see. Needs an 'lbid <num>' probe to decide. local function classifyRow (row) local best, bestKind = nil, nil local vis = norm (row.visible) for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do local kind = nil if piecesMatch (vis, w.pieces) then kind = "sure" elseif row.truncated and couldMatchTruncated (vis, w.pieces) then kind = "maybe" elseif row.truncated and gCfg.deep then kind = "maybe" end if kind then -- prefer a sure match, then the higher maximum if not best or (kind == "sure" and bestKind == "maybe") or (kind == bestKind and w.max > best.max) then best, bestKind = w, kind end end end return bestKind, best end
-- ===================================================================== -- Rendering -- ===================================================================== local function renderRow (row) local w = row.entry local st = row.stats -- A buyout heard on the market channel is authoritative; fall back to it -- when the stats box did not yield one. if st and not st.buyout then st.buyout = gKnownBuyout [row.num] end local name = (st and st.name) or (row.visible .. (row.truncated and "..." or ""))
-- header line: number, name, level, currency ColourNote ( CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-6d ", row.num), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-44s ", name:sub (1, 44)), CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("L%-4s %s", tostring (row.level or "?"), row.ctype or "?"))
-- detail line: bid / bidder / time / buyout local detail = string.format (" bid %s (%d bid%s)", commafy (row.bid or 0), row.bids, row.bids == 1 and "" or "s") if st and st.bidder then detail = detail .. " high: " .. st.bidder end detail = detail .. " ends " .. (row.timeleft or "?") if st and st.buyout then detail = detail .. " buyout " .. commafy (st.buyout) end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", detail) if st and st.seller then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " sold by " .. st.seller) end
-- action line ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format (" watch %q your max %s", w.raw, commafy (w.max)))
-- Items already bid on never reach here - they are filtered out of the scan -- entirely, because a standing proxy bid needs no further attention. local reasons = {} if row.ctype ~= "Gold" then reasons [#reasons + 1] = "not a gold auction" end -- Rows priced past our max are filtered out before this point, both from -- the list and again after the stats probe. if row.kind == "maybe" and not (st and st.name) then reasons [#reasons + 1] = "name is cut off and could not be confirmed" end
local canBuy = st and st.buyout and w.max >= st.buyout and row.ctype == "Gold" and not (row.kind == "maybe" and not st.name)
if #reasons > 0 then ColourNote (CLR_WARN, "", " no bid link: " .. table.concat (reasons, "; ")) if not canBuy then return end end
ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") if #reasons == 0 then local bidPreview = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (row.num)) :gsub ("%$amt", intstr (w.max)) Hyperlink ("mwbid " .. row.num, "[ BID up to " .. commafy (w.max) .. " ]", "Re-check this item, then send: " .. bidPreview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) if canBuy then ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") end end if canBuy then Hyperlink ("mwbuy " .. row.num, "[ BUY OUT " .. commafy (st.buyout) .. " ]", "Buy this item outright for " .. commafy (st.buyout), CLR_NAME, "black", 0, 1) end ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") end
local function renderResults () gScanning = false local n = #gOrder
-- say what was left out, so "hidden" never means "silently lost" local skipped = {} if gHidBid > 0 then skipped [#skipped + 1] = gHidBid .. " already bid" end if gHidPrice > 0 then skipped [#skipped + 1] = gHidPrice .. " over your max" end local hidden = #skipped > 0 and (" (" .. table.concat (skipped, ", ") .. ", hidden)") or ""
if n == 0 then if #skipped > 0 then echoHi ("nothing to act on - ", table.concat (skipped, " and "), " among your watched items.") else echoHi ("nothing on the market matches your ", tostring (#gWatch), " watched item(s).") end return end echoHi ("", tostring (n), " match" .. (n == 1 and "" or "es") .. " on the market" .. hidden) Note ("") for _, num in ipairs (gOrder) do local row = gRows [num] if row and row.entry then renderRow (row) end end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " Links re-verify the item with a fresh 'lbid' read before anything is sent.") end
-- ===================================================================== -- Probe queue: resolve full names / buyout / high bidder -- ===================================================================== function MW_ProbeDone (num, lines) local row = gRows [num] if row then row.stats = parseStats (num, textsOf (lines)) dbg ("probe " .. num .. " name=" .. tostring (row.stats.name) .. " buyout=" .. tostring (row.stats.buyout) .. " bidder=" .. tostring (row.stats.bidder)) -- a "maybe" row is only kept if the full name really does match if row.kind == "maybe" then local full = row.stats.name if full and piecesMatch (norm (full), row.entry.pieces) then row.kind = "sure" elseif full then row.entry = nil -- confirmed NOT a match - drop it dbg ("probe " .. num .. " ruled out") end -- full == nil: parser could not read the name; renderRow refuses a link end -- The stats box is fresher than the list, so the bid may have moved past -- our max in between. Drop it rather than show something unactionable. if row.entry and row.stats.bid and row.stats.bid >= row.entry.max then row.entry = nil gHidPrice = gHidPrice + 1 dbg ("probe " .. num .. " dropped - bidding is past our max") end end DoAfterSpecial (gCfg.probe_delay, "MW_NextProbe ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_ProbeTimeout (num) dbg ("probe " .. tostring (num) .. " timed out") DoAfterSpecial (gCfg.probe_delay, "MW_NextProbe ()", sendto.script) end
function MW_NextProbe () if #gQueue == 0 then -- drop rows that the probe ruled out local keep = {} for _, num in ipairs (gOrder) do if gRows [num] and gRows [num].entry then keep [#keep + 1] = num end end gOrder = keep renderResults () return end local num = table.remove (gQueue, 1) gProbeCount = gProbeCount + 1 local ok, err = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, probeCmd (num), true, true, true, function (lines) MW_ProbeDone (num, lines) end, false, function () MW_ProbeTimeout (num) end, 12) if not ok then dbg ("probe " .. num .. " failed to start: " .. tostring (err)) MW_ProbeTimeout (num) end end
-- ===================================================================== -- 'market list' capture -- ===================================================================== function MW_ListCaptured (lines) gOrder, gQueue, gProbeCount, gHidBid, gHidPrice = {}, {}, 0, 0, 0
-- Rows are NOT cleared: an item announced on the market channel lives here -- too, and a scan should not kill its links. Drop only what has expired. local cutoff = os.time () - SCAN_TTL for num, r in pairs (gRows) do if (r.seen or 0) < cutoff then gRows [num] = nil end end
local seen, onMarket, sawFooter = 0, {}, false for _, styles in ipairs (lines or {}) do local text = styleText (styles) -- the list ends with "Type: 'market bid <num>' to see stats and ..." if text:find ("to see stats", 1, true) then sawFooter = true end local row = parseListRow (text) if row then seen = seen + 1 onMarket [row.num] = true local kind, entry = classifyRow (row) if kind then if gBid [row.num] then -- Already bid: the proxy stands until the auction ends, so there is -- nothing left to decide. Drop it before it costs an lbid probe. gHidBid = gHidBid + 1 elseif row.bid and row.bid >= entry.max then -- Bidding has already passed what we are willing to pay. The list -- gives us the current bid, so this costs no probe either. gHidPrice = gHidPrice + 1 else row.kind = kind row.entry = entry row.seen = os.time () gRows [row.num] = row gOrder [#gOrder + 1] = row.num end end end end
dbg ("market list: " .. seen .. " rows, " .. #gOrder .. " candidate(s)")
if seen == 0 then gScanning = false warn ("could not read 'market list' - is the market up? Try: marketw debug on") return end
-- Forget bids on items that have left the market, so the ledger cannot grow -- without bound or block a number the market later reuses. -- -- A bid item STAYS in 'market list' until its auction ends - that is exactly -- how we know to keep ignoring it. So absence from the list is only -- meaningful if we actually read the whole list: a capture that got cut off -- would otherwise un-ignore everything it missed and offer it all again. -- Only prune when the closing "Type: 'market bid ...'" footer was seen. if sawFooter then local pruned = 0 for num in pairs (gBid) do if not onMarket [num] then gBid [num] = nil pruned = pruned + 1 end end for num in pairs (gKnownBuyout) do if not onMarket [num] then gKnownBuyout [num] = nil pruned = pruned + 1 end end if pruned > 0 then saveData () dbg ("pruned " .. pruned .. " finished auction(s) from the ledgers") end else dbg ("no list footer seen - capture may be partial, ledgers left alone") end
-- probe every candidate: needed for the full name, the high bidder and the -- buyout price for _, num in ipairs (gOrder) do if #gQueue < gCfg.probe_max then gQueue [#gQueue + 1] = num end end if #gOrder > gCfg.probe_max then warn ("more than " .. gCfg.probe_max .. " candidates - only the first " .. gCfg.probe_max .. " were checked in detail.") end
if #gQueue == 0 then renderResults () else echoHi ("checking ", tostring (#gQueue), " item(s) in detail...") MW_NextProbe () end end
function MW_ListTimeout () gScanning = false warn ("'market list' timed out.") end
-- ===================================================================== -- The pop-up prompt window -- -- Appears when a watched item shows up somewhere you can act on right now: -- a new market listing whose buyout is at or under your max, or a live -- auction. Each entry gets a link that does the thing; one "No" closes it. -- -- Built on the client's themed_miniwindows. A TextRect hyperlink whose text -- is not a URL is run through loadstring(), so the link text below is plain -- Lua that calls back into this plugin. -- ===================================================================== local gHaveWin = pcall (require, "themed_miniwindows")
local WIN_ID = "MarketWatch_prompt" local POPUP_TTL = 60 -- seconds a prompt stays up if you never answer it local gWin = nil local gPrompts = {} -- see popupAdd for the entry shape
local popupClose, popupBuild
local gColCache = {} local function col (hex) if not gColCache [hex] then gColCache [hex] = ColourNameToRGB (hex) end return gColCache [hex] end
-- Build one line of MUSHclient style runs plus its hyperlink list. -- Positions are counted over the VISIBLE text only, which is what TextRect -- indexes against - hence building styles directly instead of colour codes. local function promptLine (segs) local styles, links, pos = {}, {}, 1 for _, s in ipairs (segs) do if s.text ~= "" then styles [#styles + 1] = { text = s.text, textcolour = col (s.colour or CLR_MSG) } if s.code then links [#links + 1] = { start = pos, stop = pos + #s.text - 1, text = s.code, label = s.tip } end pos = pos + #s.text end end return styles, links end
-- Tearing the window down from inside one of its OWN hotspot callbacks (which -- is where a link click runs) leaves MUSHclient with live hotspots pointing at -- an object that no longer exists: the window stays on screen, the close button -- does nothing, and the next right-click dies in RightClickMenuCallback with a -- nil window. So every teardown is pushed onto a timer and happens after the -- callback has returned. The library's own close button defers for the same -- reason (it calls delete(true)). function MW_PopupDestroy () local w = gWin gWin = nil gPrompts = {} if w then pcall (function () w:delete (true) end) end pcall (WindowDelete, WIN_ID) -- also clears a window left behind by a pcall (Repaint) -- half-finished teardown end
function MW_PopupRefresh () popupBuild () end

-- Add a prompt. Returns true when the pop-up has taken responsibility for -- this item, so the caller can skip its normal echo and not say it twice. -- -- p = { id, family = "mkt"|"auc", num, name, note, -- bid = <amount>, bidkind = "bid"|"auc", -- optional -- buy = <buyout> } -- optional local gPromptSeq = 0
local function popupAdd (p) if not gCfg.popup or not gHaveWin then return false end for _, q in ipairs (gPrompts) do -- market and auction numbers are different spaces, so match on both if q.num == p.num and q.family == p.family then return true end end gPromptSeq = gPromptSeq + 1 p.id = gPromptSeq p.when = os.time () gPrompts [#gPrompts + 1] = p popupBuild () -- Never leave it sitting there if nobody is at the keyboard. DoAfterSpecial (POPUP_TTL + 1, "MW_PopupExpire ()", sendto.script) -- Only claim it if a window really exists now. If the build failed the -- item must go back to the normal echo rather than vanish from both. if not gWin then for i, q in ipairs (gPrompts) do if q.id == p.id then table.remove (gPrompts, i) break end end return false end return true end
-- Called by a link click. The id makes this unambiguous - matching on the -- item number alone could hit the wrong entry, since auction 97 and market 97 -- are different items. function MW_PopupAct (id, action) id = tonumber (id) if not id then return end local target for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.id == id then target = p break end end if not target then return end if target.pending then return end -- already waiting on this one
-- The prompt is NOT removed here. Whether the bid actually goes through is -- only known once the MUD answers, and if it fails for want of gold the -- window has to stay up with the buttons still on it. target.pending = true target.problem = nil target.when = os.time () -- restart its expiry clock
local num = target.num if action == "auc" then MW_Click_AucBid (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) elseif action == "buy" then MW_Click_Buy (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) elseif action == "buyover" then -- you clicked a button that spells out the price, so the max is waived MW_Click_Buy (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }, true) else MW_Click_Bid (nil, nil, { tostring (num) }) end -- redraw once we are out of the click callback, same reasoning as the -- deferred teardown above DoAfterSpecial (0.2, "MW_PopupRefresh ()", sendto.script) DoAfterSpecial (6, "MW_PopupSettle (" .. id .. ")", sendto.script) end
-- A few seconds after acting, decide what happened. The ledger is the -- evidence: a bid that went through is recorded there, and one that failed -- has been un-recorded again by MW_NotEnoughGold. function MW_PopupSettle (id) id = tonumber (id) local target, index for i, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.id == id then target, index = p, i break end end if not target or not target.pending then return end
local placed = (target.family == "auc") and gAucBid [target.num] or (target.family ~= "auc") and gBid [target.num]
if placed then target.pending = false table.remove (gPrompts, index) -- done with it popupBuild () return end
-- Not recorded yet. A market bid re-reads the item with a silent lbid -- first, which can outlast this timer, so give it a couple more goes before -- calling it a failure. target.settleTries = (target.settleTries or 0) + 1 if target.settleTries < 3 then DoAfterSpecial (6, "MW_PopupSettle (" .. id .. ")", sendto.script) return end
target.pending = false if not target.problem then target.problem = "that did not go through - still yours to take" end popupBuild () end
-- Called when the MUD refuses a bid. Keeps the prompt on screen, says why. local function popupFail (family, num, message) for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if p.num == num and p.family == family then p.pending = false p.problem = message p.when = os.time () -- give it a fresh minute to act on popupBuild () return true end end return false end

-- Drop anything that has sat unanswered for too long. function MW_PopupExpire () local now, kept = os.time (), {} for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do if now - (p.when or 0) < POPUP_TTL then kept [#kept + 1] = p end end if #kept == #gPrompts then return end gPrompts = kept popupBuild () -- closes the window if that emptied it end
-- Drop the prompt for an item that is no longer for sale. Called from the -- "sold" lines on both channels - who won does not matter, the chance is gone. local function popupDrop (family, num, name) local kept, dropped = {}, false local target = name and norm (name) or nil for _, p in ipairs (gPrompts) do local hit = (p.family == family) and ((num and p.num == num) or (target and target ~= "" and norm (p.name) == target)) if hit then dropped = true else kept [#kept + 1] = p end end if not dropped then return end gPrompts = kept popupBuild () end
-- "Auction: A Trivia Point Token SOLD to Madrox for 12,000,665 gold." function MW_AuctionSold (name, line, wildcards) line = tostring (line) -- the market's own sold line carries a "Num nnnnn" - that one is not ours if line:find ("Num%s+%d+") then return end local item = line:match ("^%s*[Aa]uction:%s*(.-)%s+SOLD to") or line:match ("^%s*(.-)%s+SOLD to") if not item or item == "" then return end popupDrop ("auc", nil, item) end
-- "Market: (Vibrant) {>-Long dark green leaf-<} (Level 198, Num 64808) sold to Pigmao for 5,250,000 Gold." function MW_MarketSold (name, line, wildcards) local num = tonumber (tostring (line):match ("%(Level%s+%d+,%s*Num%s+(%d+)%)%s+sold to")) if not num then return end popupDrop ("mkt", num, nil) -- it has left the market, so the ledgers should forget it now rather than -- waiting for the next scan to notice if gBid [num] or gKnownBuyout [num] then gBid [num] = nil gKnownBuyout [num] = nil saveData () end gRows [num] = nil end
-- ===================================================================== -- The LIVE auction channel -- -- Sample line this was written against: -- Auction: Betrayal is auctioning a Trivia Point Token (Level 1, Num 97). -- Current bid is 100. -- -- Unlike the market list, the auction line carries the FULL item name, so a -- match here is exact and needs no probing. The bid also uses a different -- command and a different number space - see CMD_AUC and gAucBid. -- ===================================================================== local gAuc = {} -- auction num -> { name, level, bid, entry, when } local gAucLast = { line = "", when = 0 }
-- Pick the best watch entry for a full, untruncated item name. local function matchWatch (fullname) local hay, best = norm (fullname), nil for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do if piecesMatch (hay, w.pieces) then if not best or w.max > best.max then best = w end end end return best end
function MW_AuctionDebug (name, line, wildcards) if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw auc] " .. tostring (line)) end end
function MW_AuctionLine (name, line, wildcards) if not gCfg.auc then return end line = tostring (line)
-- the channel repeats itself; ignore an identical line seen seconds ago local now = os.time () if line == gAucLast.line and now - gAucLast.when < 5 then return end gAucLast.line, gAucLast.when = line, now
-- "<seller> is auctioning <ITEM> (Level <n>, Num <n>)" local item, level, num = line:match ("is auctioning%s+(.-)%s*%(Level%s+(%d+),%s*Num%s+(%d+)%)") num = tonumber (num) level = tonumber (level) if not item or item == "" or not num then if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw auc] could not parse: " .. line) end return end
-- "Current bid is 100." - absent on some lines, so it stays nil local cur = line:match ("[Cc]urrent bid is%s+([%d,]+)") cur = cur and tonumber ((cur:gsub (",", ""))) or nil
local w = matchWatch (item) if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("[marketw auc] item=%q level=%s num=%d bid=%s match=%s", item, tostring (level), num, tostring (cur), w and w.raw or "none")) end if not w then return end -- already bid: the bid stands, so say nothing at all if gAucBid [num] then return end -- bidding is already past what we would pay: nothing to act on, stay quiet if cur and cur >= w.max then return end
gAuc [num] = { name = item, level = level, bid = cur, entry = w, when = now }
-- Auctions are over in minutes, so every one of these gets the pop-up. -- When the window takes it, the echo below would only say it twice. if popupAdd { family = "auc", num = num, name = item, bid = w.max, bidkind = "auc", note = "Auction " .. num .. (cur and (" current bid " .. commafy (cur)) or "") .. " your max " .. commafy (w.max) } then return end
echoHi ("auction match: ", item, string.format (" (Num %d, L%s%s)", num, tostring (level or "?"), cur and (", bid " .. commafy (cur)) or ""))
local preview = CMD_AUC:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (w.max)) ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwaucbid " .. num, "[ BID " .. commafy (w.max) .. " ]", "Send: " .. preview, CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " matches " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw)) end
function MW_Click_AucBid (name, line, wildcards) local num = tonumber (wildcards [1]) local a = gAuc [num] if not a or not a.entry then warn ("auction " .. tostring (num) .. " is not one I have seen.") return end if os.time () - a.when > AUC_TTL then warn ("that auction line is over " .. math.floor (AUC_TTL / 60) .. " minutes old - the auction has probably moved on. Nothing sent.") return end if gAucBid [num] then warn ("you already bid on auction " .. num .. " - nothing sent.") return end local amt = a.entry.max if a.bid and a.bid >= amt then warn ("refused: current bid " .. commafy (a.bid) .. " already meets your max " .. commafy (amt) .. ".") return end -- The name came from the auction line in full, so it is already an exact -- match - re-check it anyway in case the watch list changed since. if not piecesMatch (norm (a.name), a.entry.pieces) then warn ("refused: " .. string.format ("%q", a.name) .. " no longer matches " .. string.format ("%q", a.entry.raw) .. ".") return end
local cmd = CMD_AUC:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) gAucBid [num] = os.time () gLastBid = { num = num, amt = amt, auction = true, when = os.time () } saveData () echoHi ("sending: ", cmd, " (" .. a.name .. ")") Send (cmd) end

local item, level, num = line:match ("is selling%s+(.-)%s*%(Level%s+(%d+),%s*Num%s+(%d+)%)") num = tonumber (num) level = tonumber (level) if not item or item == "" or not num then return end

local num = gPendingAnnounce if not num then return end gKnownBuyout [num] = price saveData () if gRows [num] and gRows [num].stats then gRows [num].stats.buyout = price end if gCfg.aucdebug then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", "[marketw mkt] buyout " .. commafy (price) .. " for " .. num) end end
function MW_AnnounceRender (num) num = tonumber (num) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry or not row.announced then return end if row.rendered then return end row.rendered = true gPendingAnnounce = nil

Only listings with nothing to click -- (not a gold auction) fall through to the echo below. if #reasons == 0 then local note = "Num " .. num if st and st.buyout then note = note .. " buyout " .. commafy (st.buyout) end note = note .. " your max " .. commafy (w.max) -- a buyout within your max is the normal button; one above it is -- offered too, but as a separate, clearly-labelled action local buyAmt, buyOver if st and st.buyout then if canBuy then buyAmt = st.buyout else buyOver = st.buyout end end if popupAdd { family = "mkt", num = num, name = row.visible, bid = w.max, bidkind = "bid", buy = buyAmt, buyover = buyOver, note = note } then return end end

-- ===================================================================== -- Topping up from the bank when a bid falls short -- -- Only ever fires in the one room you nominate, and only within a few -- seconds of a bid we actually sent. function MW_NotEnoughGold (name, line, wildcards) local b = gLastBid if not b then return end if os.time () - b.when > BID_FAIL_WINDOW then gLastBid = nil return end gLastBid = nil
-- "You are only carrying 0 gold pieces." - authoritative, and fresher than -- the GMCP figure, so it wins when present. local carrying = tostring (line):match ("only carrying%s+([%d,]+)%s+gold") carrying = carrying and tonumber ((carrying:gsub (",", "")))
-- The bid did NOT happen, so undo the record of it - otherwise the item -- would stay hidden from every future scan for something we never bought. if b.auction then gAucBid [b.num] = nil else gBid [b.num] = nil end saveData ()

(carrying and (" (carrying " .. commafy (carrying) .. ")") or ""))
local retryAlias = b.auction and ("mwaucbid " .. b.num) or ("mwbid " .. b.num)
echoHi ("bid on item ", tostring (b.num), " failed - not enough gold on hand.") ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " it is no longer marked as bid, so it will be offered again.")
if not gCfg.withdraw then ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink (retryAlias, "[ RETRY BID ]", "Try the bid again", CLR_HI, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " ('marketw withdraw on' to top up from the bank automatically)") return end
if gCfg.withdrawroom == 0 then warn ("withdraw is on but no room is set - stand in your bank and use 'marketw withdrawroom here'.") return end local here = currentRoom () if here ~= gCfg.withdrawroom then warn ("not withdrawing: you are in room " .. tostring (here or "unknown") .. ", withdrawals are only done in room " .. gCfg.withdrawroom .. ".") if not here then ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " (room unknown - is aard_GMCP_handler loaded?)") end return end
-- Take out the FULL bid amount, not just the shortfall. " - nothing withdrawn.") return end if gBank and gBank < need then warn ("not withdrawing: the bank holds " .. commafy (gBank) .. ", short of the full " .. commafy (need) .. ".") return end
local cmd = CMD_WITHDRAW:gsub ("%$amt", intstr (need)) echoHi ("withdrawing ", commafy (need), have and (" (the full bid amount - you were carrying " .. commafy (have) .. ")") or " (the full bid amount)") Send (cmd) -- Hold the retry link back for a second. The bank prints your account -- details right after a withdrawal, and that would scroll the link away. DoAfterSpecial (1, "MW_ShowRetry (" .. intstr (b.num) .. ", " .. tostring (b.auction) .. ")", sendto.script) end

-- ===================================================================== -- Commands -- ===================================================================== function MW_Cmd_Scan () if not gHaveCapture then warn ("wrapped_captures.lua is not available - cannot read the market silently.") return end if not IsConnected () then warn ("not connected.") return end if #gWatch == 0 then echo ("your watch list is empty. Add one with:") helpLine ("market add <name> <max>", "e.g. market add a blank chaos portal 1.2b") return end if gScanning and os.time () - gScanStart < 60 then warn ("a scan is already running.") return end gScanning = true gScanStart = os.time () echo ("reading the market...") local ok, err = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, "market list", true, true, true, MW_ListCaptured, false, MW_ListTimeout, 20) if not ok then gScanning = false warn ("capture failed: " .. tostring (err)) end end
function MW_Cmd_Add (name, line, wildcards) local arg = trim (wildcards [1]) local body, amt = arg:match ("^(.-)%s+([%d%.,]+[kmbKMB]?)$") if not body then warn ("usage: market add <item name> <max bid>") helpLine ("example", "market add a shiny platinum blank chaos portal 1200000000") helpLine ("example", "market add * Fantasy Series Collector Card 6m") return end local max = parseAmount (amt) if not max then warn ("could not read " .. amt .. " as an amount.") return end body = trim (body) local pieces = splitGlob (body) if #pieces == 0 then warn ("that pattern has no actual text to match on.") return end -- a very short pattern would match half the market - refuse it local total = 0 for _, p in ipairs (pieces) do total = total + #p end if total < 4 then warn ("pattern is too short (" .. total .. " chars) - it would match almost anything.") return end for _, w in ipairs (gWatch) do if norm (w.raw) == norm (body) then local old = w.max w.max = max saveData () echoHi ("updated max for " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ": " .. commafy (old) .. " -> ", commafy (max), "") return end end gWatch [#gWatch + 1] = { raw = body, max = max, added = os.time (), pieces = pieces } saveData () echoHi ("watching " .. string.format ("%q", body) .. " up to ", commafy (max), " gold.") end
function MW_Cmd_Del (name, line, wildcards) local arg = trim (wildcards [1]) local idx = tonumber (arg) if idx and gWatch [idx] then local w = table.remove (gWatch, idx) saveData () echo ("removed " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ".") return end local target = norm (arg) for i, w in ipairs (gWatch) do if target ~= "" and norm (w.raw):find (target, 1, true) then table.remove (gWatch, i) saveData () echo ("removed " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ".") return end end warn ("no watch entry matches " .. string.format ("%q", arg) .. ". Try: marketw list") end
function MW_Cmd_List () if #gWatch == 0 then echo ("watch list is empty.") return end echoHi ("watching ", tostring (#gWatch), " item(s):") for i, w in ipairs (gWatch) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %2d. ", i), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-48s ", w.raw:sub (1, 48)), CLR_DIM, "", "max " .. commafy (w.max)) end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " bid command: " .. -- Items we have a standing proxy bid on function MW_Cmd_Bids () local nums, anums = {}, {} for num in pairs (gBid) do nums [#nums + 1] = num end for num in pairs (gAucBid) do anums [#anums + 1] = num end table.sort (nums) table.sort (anums) if #nums == 0 and #anums == 0 then echo ("no standing bids recorded.") return end
if #nums > 0 then echoHi ("market: standing bid on ", tostring (#nums), " item(s) - not offered again:") for _, num in ipairs (nums) do ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-8d", num), CLR_DIM, "", "bid " .. os.date ("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", gBid [num])) end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " These clear themselves once the item leaves the market.") end if #anums > 0 then echoHi ("auction: standing bid on ", tostring (#anums), " auction(s):") for _, num in ipairs (anums) do local a = gAuc [num] ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", string.format (" %-8d", num), CLR_MSG, "", string.format ("%-40s ", a and a.name or "?"), CLR_DIM, "", "bid " .. os.date ("%H:%M", gAucBid [num])) end ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " These expire on their own after an hour.") end end
function MW_Cmd_Deep () gCfg.deep = not gCfg.deep saveData () echoHi ("deep scan is now ", gCfg.deep and "ON" or "OFF", gCfg.deep and " - every truncated row gets an 'lbid' probe (slower)." or " - only likely rows get probed.") end
-- How hard we are willing to hammer the MUD during one scan. Each probe is -- four commands (two echo tags, the lbid, a blank line), so the defaults are -- deliberately conservative. function MW_Cmd_Throttle (name, line, wildcards) local arg = trim (wildcards [1]) if arg == "" then echoHi ("at most ", tostring (gCfg.probe_max), " item(s) checked per scan, " .. gCfg.probe_delay .. "s apart.") ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " marketw throttle <max> [seconds]") return end local mx, dl = arg:match ("^(%d+)%s*([%d%.]*)$") mx = tonumber (mx) if not mx or mx < 1 then warn ("usage: marketw throttle <max> [seconds]") return end gCfg.probe_max = math.min (mx, 200) local d = tonumber (dl) if d and d >= 0.1 then gCfg.probe_delay = d end saveData () echoHi ("now checking at most ", tostring (gCfg.probe_max), " item(s) per scan, " .. gCfg.probe_delay .. "s apart.") end

-- Dump the raw item stats box (useful if the format ever changes). function MW_Cmd_Probe (name, line, wildcards) if not gHaveCapture then warn ("wrapped_captures.lua not available.") return end local num = tonumber (wildcards [1]) echoHi ("probing item ", tostring (num), " with '" .. probeCmd (num) .. "' - raw output follows:") Capture.untagged_output (probeCmd (num), true, true, true, function (lines) local texts = textsOf (lines) for i, t in ipairs (texts) do ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", string.format ("%3d| ", i) .. t) end local st = parseStats (num, texts) ColourNote (CLR_HI, "", " parsed -> name=" .. tostring (st.name) .. " buyout=" .. tostring (st.buyout) .. " bidder=" .. tostring (st.bidder) .. " bid=" .. tostring (st.bid) .. " minbid=" .. tostring (st.minbid)) end, false, function () warn ("probe timed out.") end, 12) end

-- ===================================================================== -- Clicking a bid link -- ===================================================================== local function sendBid (row, amt, why) local cmd = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (row.num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) gBid [row.num] = os.time () gLastBid = { num = row.num, amt = amt, auction = false, when = os.time () } saveData () echoHi ("sending: ", cmd, why and (" (" .. why .. ")") or "") Send (cmd) ColourNote (CLR_DIM, "", " item " .. row.num .. " will not be offered again.") end
-- second stage: fresh stats are in, decide whether to send local function bidVerified (num, forced) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry then warn ("item " .. num .. " is no longer in the last scan.") return end local w = row.entry local st = row.stats local amt = w.max
if row.ctype ~= "Gold" then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is a " .. tostring (row.ctype) .. " auction, not gold.") return end
if not st or not st.name then if not forced then local preview = CMD_BID:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)):gsub ("%$amt", intstr (amt)) warn ("could not re-read item " .. num .. " to confirm it. Nothing sent.") ColourTell (CLR_MSG, "", " ") Hyperlink ("mwbidforce " .. num, "[ SEND ANYWAY: " .. preview .. " ]", "Send the bid without confirmation", CLR_WARN, "black", 0, 1) ColourNote (CLR_MSG, "", "") return end else if not piecesMatch (norm (st.name), w.pieces) then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is " .. string.format ("%q", st.name) .. ", which does not match " .. string.format ("%q", w.raw) .. ".") return end -- the stats box states the currency on the bid line ("25,000,000 gold") if st.currency and st.currency:lower () ~= "gold" then warn ("refused: item " .. num .. " is priced in " .. st.currency .. ", not gold.") return end local cur = st.bid or row.bid or 0 if cur >= amt then warn ("refused: current bid " .. commafy (cur) .. " already meets your max " .. commafy (amt) .. ".") return end if st.minbid and st.minbid > amt then warn ("refused: minimum next bid " .. commafy (st.minbid) .. " is over your max " .. commafy (amt) .. ".") return end if st.bidder and gmcp_name and st.bidder:lower () == gmcp_name:lower () then warn ("refused: you are already the high bidder on item " .. num .. ".") return end end
sendBid (row, amt, st and st.name or nil) end
local function clickBid (num, forced) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry then warn ("item " .. tostring (num) .. " is not in the current scan. Run 'marketw' again.") return end if os.time () - (row.seen or 0) > SCAN_TTL then warn ("that listing is over " .. math.floor (SCAN_TTL / 60) .. " minutes old. Run 'marketw' again first.") return end if gBid [num] then warn ("you already have a proxy bid on item " .. num .. " - nothing sent.") return end if forced then bidVerified (num, true) return end
echo ("re-checking item " .. num .. " before bidding...") local ok = pcall (Capture.untagged_output, probeCmd (num), true, true, true, function (lines) if gRows [num] then gRows [num].stats = parseStats (num, textsOf (lines)) end bidVerified (num, false) end, false, function () warn ("re-check timed out - nothing sent.") end, 12) if not ok then warn ("re-check failed to start - nothing sent.") end end
function MW_Click_Bid (name, line, wildcards) clickBid (tonumber (wildcards [1]), false) end function MW_Click_BidForce (name, line, wildcards) clickBid (tonumber (wildcards [1]), true) end
function MW_Click_Buy (name, line, wildcards, force) local num = tonumber (wildcards [1]) local row = gRows [num] if not row or not row.entry or not row.stats or not row.stats.buyout then warn ("no confirmed buyout price for item " .. tostring (num) .. ". Run 'marketw' again.") return end if gBid [num] then warn ("you already have a bid on item " .. num .. " - nothing sent.") return end if not force and row.entry.max < row.stats.buyout then warn ("refused: buyout " .. commafy (row.stats.buyout) .. " is over your max " .. commafy (row.entry.max) .. ".") return end if force and row.entry.max < row.stats.buyout then warn ("buying over your max: " .. commafy (row.stats.buyout) .. " vs " .. commafy (row.entry.max) .. " - you asked for this one.") end -- send exactly the buyout price, not your max local cmd = CMD_BUY:gsub ("%$num", intstr (num)) :gsub ("%$amt", intstr (row.stats.buyout)) gBid [num] = os.time () gLastBid = { num = num, amt = row.stats.buyout, auction = false, when = os.time () } saveData () echoHi ("sending: ", cmd, " (buyout on " .. (row.stats.name or "item " .. num) .. ")") Send (cmd) end
-- ===================================================================== -- GMCP: remember our own character name (used to skip our own high bids) -- ===================================================================== gmcp_name = nil function OnPluginTelnetSubnegotiation (theType, data) if theType ~= 201 then return end -- Route on the message name. Matching '"name"' in every packet would pick -- up room.info's ROOM name and store it as the character name. local msg = data:match ("^([%w%.%-_]+)") if not msg then return end msg = msg:lower ()
if msg == "char.base" then local n = data:match ('"name"%s*:%s*"([^"]+)"') if n then gmcp_name = n end
elseif msg == "room.info" then local n = data:match ('"num"%s*:%s*(%-?%d+)') if n then gRoom = tonumber (n) end
elseif msg == "char.worth" then local g = data:match ('"gold"%s*:%s*(%d+)') local k = data:match ('"bank"%s*:%s*(%d+)') if g then gGold = tonumber (g) end if k then gBank = tonumber (k) end end end
